title: Fiscal Responsibility And Budget Management Act 2003
definition: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act, 2003 is a landmark legislation enacted to institutionalize financial discipline, reduce India's fiscal deficit, macro-economic stability, and ensure inter-generational equity in fiscal management.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Examination under GS Paper III (Indian Economy - Government Budgeting, Fiscal Policy, Mobilization of Resources) and Prelims (Economy current affairs, statutory acts, macroeconomic indicators).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Fiscal Responsibility And Budget Management Act 2003.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Concepts of Fiscal Deficit, Revenue Deficit, and Primary Deficit
